```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

require(vitae)
require(tibble)
require(dplyr)
require(readxl)
require(glue)
require(here)

# Load all data from Excel
excel_file <- here("jpbsCVdata", "cv_data_with_education.xlsx")

# Read Administrative data
admin <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Administrative") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Read Education data - ensure consistent column naming
edu <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Education") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", "),
    institution = institution,  # Keep as institution
    degree = degree,
    startYear = as.character(start_year),
    endYear = as.character(end_year),
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(detail_1) & !is.na(detail_2) & !is.na(detail_3) ~ 
        paste(detail_1, detail_2, detail_3, sep = "; "),
      !is.na(detail_1) & !is.na(detail_2) ~ 
        paste(detail_1, detail_2, sep = "; "),
      !is.na(detail_1) ~ detail_1,
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# Read Certifications
certifications <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Certifications") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    certBody = cert_body,
    accomplishment = accomplishment,
    year = as.character(year),
    where = if_else(is.na(where), "", where),
    detail = if_else(is.na(detail), "", detail)
  )

# Read Employment data - Handle Month-Year format
employment <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Employment") %>%
  mutate(
    start_sort = paste0(
      sub(".*-", "", if_else(is.na(start_date), "2000", start_date)),
      "-",
      case_when(
        grepl("January", start_date) ~ "01",
        grepl("February", start_date) ~ "02",
        grepl("March", start_date) ~ "03",
        grepl("April", start_date) ~ "04",
        grepl("May", start_date) ~ "05",
        grepl("June", start_date) ~ "06",
        grepl("July", start_date) ~ "07",
        grepl("August", start_date) ~ "08",
        grepl("September", start_date) ~ "09",
        grepl("October", start_date) ~ "10",
        grepl("November", start_date) ~ "11",
        grepl("December", start_date) ~ "12",
        TRUE ~ "00"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(current), desc(start_sort))

# Process Long-term employment
ltWork <- employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | (!is.na(end_date) & as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", end_date)) >= 1997)) %>%
  mutate(
    institution = institution,
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" & 
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0("• ", position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles, 
               "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" ~ 
        paste0("• ", position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles),
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0("• ", position_title, "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      TRUE ~ position_title
    ),
    startMonth = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", start_date), ""),
    startYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub(".*-", "", start_date), ""),
    endMonth = case_when(
      is.na(end_date) | current == TRUE ~ "Present",
      TRUE ~ sub("-.*", "", end_date)
    ),
    endYear = case_when(
      is.na(end_date) | current == TRUE ~ "",
      TRUE ~ sub(".*-", "", end_date)
    ),
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", ")
  )

# Process Short-term employment
stWork <- employment %>%
  filter(current == FALSE & !is.na(end_date) & as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", end_date)) < 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    institution = institution,
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" & 
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0("• ", position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles, 
               "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" ~ 
        paste0("• ", position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles),
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0("• ", position_title, "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      TRUE ~ position_title
    ),
    startMonth = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", start_date), ""),
    startYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub(".*-", "", start_date), ""),
    endMonth = if_else(!is.na(end_date), sub("-.*", "", end_date), ""),
    endYear = if_else(!is.na(end_date), sub(".*-", "", end_date), ""),
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", ")
  )

# Read Publications
publications <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Publications") %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    articleTitle = title,
    authors = authors,
    journal = case_when(
      !is.na(volume) & !is.na(issue) & !is.na(pages) ~ 
        paste0(journal, ", v", volume, " n", issue, ", ", pages),
      !is.na(volume) & !is.na(pages) ~ 
        paste0(journal, ", v", volume, ", ", pages),
      !is.na(volume) ~ paste0(journal, ", v", volume),
      TRUE ~ journal
    ),
    year = as.character(year)
  )

# Read Honors and Grants
honorsGrants <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Honors") %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    honorGrant = honor_grant,
    grantor = grantor,
    year = as.character(year),
    where = if_else(is.na(location), "", location),
    detail = if_else(is.na(notes), "", notes)
  )

# Read Working Papers
pip <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "WorkingPapers") %>%
  mutate(
    articleTitle = title,
    authors = authors,
    status = if_else(is.na(status), "", status)
  )

# Read Other Publications
otherPubsMonos <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "OtherPublications") %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    title = title,
    authors = authors,
    outlet = if_else(is.na(outlet), "", outlet),
    year = as.character(year)
  )
```
